hooks.command:
echo "
=== CodeJudgeX Shutdown Protocol (AGENTS.md) ===
1. Write session digest → .obsidian-ai-memory/01-SESSIONS/YYYY-MM-DD/session-HHMM-claude.md
2. Overwrite session-continuity.md
3. Update active-goals.md checkboxes
4. Append to error-memory.md if a bug was fixed
5. Append to decisions.md if a non-trivial decision was made
6. CODE COMMIT:   git add backend/ frontend/ infra/ docs/
                  git commit -m 'feat|fix|refactor|docs(scope): description'
7. MEMORY COMMIT: git add .obsidian-ai-memory/ AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md .claude/ .cursor/
                  git commit -m 'memory: YYYY-MM-DD claude — summary'
8. git push origin HEAD
9. Final reply must include ## Memory block (digest path, commit hashes, push status)
================================================"
echo "[CodeJudgeX] Pre-edit check: session-continuity.md + error-memory.md read this session?"
